ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the left side is Region 1, and the right side is Region 2. There are two parallel interconnection channels between the two regions: the upper one is an HVDC link with converter symbols, and it is labeled with DC power Pdc; the lower one is an AC line, and it is labeled with AC line power Pac. Reasoning: The problem is limited to steady state, and only the HVDC converter is controlled. The HVDC converter can directly regulate the active power Pdc transmitted on the HVDC link. Since the HVDC link and the AC line are parallel channels connecting the same two regions, when Pdc is regulated, the distribution of transmission power between the DC link and the AC line between the same regions will change accordingly. Therefore, what can be changed by controlling only the HVDC converter is the power sharing between the AC line and the HVDC link.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: Region 1 and Region 2 are tied by both an HVDC link and an AC line, with powers Pdc and Pac shown on the two paths. From the question, only the HVDC converters are controlled and the condition is steady state. Use the rule that converter controls can adjust active power through the HVDC link. Since the AC and DC links are parallel interconnections between the same two regions, adjusting Pdc changes the division of transferred power between the upper HVDC path and the lower AC path. Therefore the controllable quantity is the power sharing between the AC line and the HVDC link.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the two regions are connected by an HVDC branch carrying Pdc and an AC branch carrying Pac. Treat the net steady-state transfer from one region to the other as Ptotal = Pac + Pdc. The text says only the HVDC converters are controlled; in steady state, these converters can change the commanded DC power Pdc. For a given operating balance of the two regional systems, changing Pdc changes the residual amount that must flow on the AC line, Pac = Ptotal - Pdc. Thus converter control alone can alter the split, or power sharing, between the AC line and the HVDC link.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是 Region 1，右侧是 Region 2。两个区域之间有两条并联的互联通道：上方是标为 HVDC link 的直流输电支路，包含换流器符号，并标出功率 Pdc 的方向；下方是标为 AC line 的交流线路，并标出功率 Pac 的方向。推理：稳态下，两区域之间的净传输功率可看作 Ptotal = Pac + Pdc。若只控制 HVDC 换流器，能够改变 HVDC 支路的有功功率指令 Pdc。在两区域发电与负荷平衡给定、总传输 Ptotal 给定时，AC 线路承担的功率变为 Pac = Ptotal - Pdc。因此，单独控制 HVDC 换流器不能任意改变总平衡，但可以改变 AC 线和 HVDC 链路之间承担功率的比例，即功率分配。
